reviews.title: I used to love this game
reviews.text: This game used to be so fun a few years ago, but now it feels like it the developers have lost the plot. It used to be simple and easy to understand, but now there are tons of different mechanics, which sounds like a good thing at first, more content is typically good, but in this case it just gets really overwhelming and complex, when the game used to have this simple charm. There’s also tons of ads now. Back in the day, there weren’t forced ads, only the occasional pop-up ads to get rewards. Overall the game feels like it moved away from a passion project into a cash grab and it’s pretty disappointing to see.
